-- Onboarding workspace V1. Additive migration only: existing seller calls and attribution are untouched.

ALTER TABLE agents ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_super_admin BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace_access (
  agent_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  workspace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (workspace IN ('seller','onboarding')),
  access_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (access_level IN ('agent','admin')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, workspace)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workspace_access_workspace_idx ON workspace_access(workspace, access_level);

-- Preserve today's seller permissions when the new model is introduced.
INSERT INTO workspace_access(agent_id, workspace, access_level)
SELECT id, 'seller', CASE WHEN role='admin' THEN 'admin' ELSE 'agent' END
FROM agents
ON CONFLICT (agent_id, workspace) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_disposition_nodes (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  level SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (level BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
  parent_id UUID REFERENCES onboarding_disposition_nodes(id),
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_disposition_parent_idx ON onboarding_disposition_nodes(parent_id, sort_order);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_cases (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('seller_handoff','manual_admin','historical_import')),
  source_seller_call_id UUID REFERENCES calls(id),
  source_seller_agent_id UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  source_seller_disposition TEXT,
  sale_date DATE,
  assigned_to UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  current_l0 TEXT,
  current_l1 TEXT,
  current_l2 TEXT,
  current_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (current_status IN ('open','ads_live','lost','closed')),
  next_callback_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  last_activity_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  ads_live_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_by UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_one_open_case_per_customer_idx
  ON onboarding_cases(customer_id)
  WHERE current_status='open';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_cases_assignee_idx ON onboarding_cases(assigned_to, current_status, next_callback_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_cases_customer_idx ON onboarding_cases(customer_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_events (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  onboarding_case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES onboarding_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  event_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date),
  agent_id UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  agent_name_raw TEXT,
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('new_event','historical_import','assignment','system')),
  source_sheet TEXT,
  source_row INTEGER,
  source_call_num TEXT,
  l0_code TEXT,
  l1_code TEXT,
  l2_code TEXT,
  l0_label_snapshot TEXT,
  l1_label_snapshot TEXT,
  l2_label_snapshot TEXT,
  remark TEXT,
  callback_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(onboarding_case_id, attempt_number)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_events_case_idx ON onboarding_events(onboarding_case_id, attempt_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_events_agent_idx ON onboarding_events(agent_id, event_time);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_events_callback_idx ON onboarding_events(agent_id, callback_at) WHERE callback_at IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS technical_cases (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  onboarding_case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES onboarding_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  issue_code TEXT,
  issue_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','resolved')),
  opened_by UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  assigned_to UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  opened_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  resolved_by UUID REFERENCES agents(id),
  resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  latest_remark TEXT,
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new_event' CHECK (source_type IN ('new_event','historical_import')),
  source_sheet TEXT,
  source_row INTEGER,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS technical_cases_open_idx ON technical_cases(assigned_to, status, opened_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS technical_cases_customer_idx ON technical_cases(customer_id, opened_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS access_audit_log (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  target_agent_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(id),
  changed_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(id),
  previous_access JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  new_access JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- V1 onboarding taxonomy.
WITH l0 AS (
  INSERT INTO onboarding_disposition_nodes(code,label,level,sort_order) VALUES
    ('OB_IN_PROCESS','In Process',0,10),
    ('OB_NOT_CONNECTED','Not Connected',0,20),
    ('OB_NOT_INTERESTED_REFUND','Not Interested / Refund',0,30),
    ('OB_ADS_LIVE','Ads Live',0,40)
  ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET label=EXCLUDED.label, active=TRUE, sort_order=EXCLUDED.sort_order
  RETURNING id,code
)
SELECT 1;

INSERT INTO onboarding_disposition_nodes(code,label,level,parent_id,sort_order)
SELECT x.code,x.label,1,p.id,x.sort_order
FROM (VALUES
  ('OB_CALLBACK','Callback',10),
  ('OB_TECHNICAL','Technical Issue',20),
  ('OB_FB_LINKING','Facebook linking',30),
  ('OB_AD_SETUP','Ad setup',40),
  ('OB_OTHER_PROCESS','Other',50)
) x(code,label,sort_order)
JOIN onboarding_disposition_nodes p ON p.code='OB_IN_PROCESS'
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET label=EXCLUDED.label,parent_id=EXCLUDED.parent_id,active=TRUE,sort_order=EXCLUDED.sort_order;

INSERT INTO onboarding_disposition_nodes(code,label,level,parent_id,sort_order)
SELECT x.code,x.label,2,p.id,x.sort_order
FROM (VALUES
  ('OB_TECH_ACCOUNT_LOAD','We Could Not Load Your Account',10),
  ('OB_TECH_CAMPAIGN_START','Campaign / ad could not start',20),
  ('OB_TECH_AD_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED','Ad account restricted',30),
  ('OB_TECH_PAGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE','Page not eligible',40),
  ('OB_TECH_PAGE_NOT_FOUND','Page not found',50),
  ('OB_TECH_FB_LOGIN','Facebook login issue',60),
  ('OB_TECH_WHITE_SCREEN','White screen / linking issue',70),
  ('OB_TECH_WABA_MISSING','WABA number missing',80),
  ('OB_TECH_LOW_BALANCE','Low balance / payment issue',90),
  ('OB_TECH_SUBSCRIPTION','Subscription issue',100),
  ('OB_TECH_AD_CREATE','Unable to create ad',110),
  ('OB_TECH_OTHER','Other technical issue',120)
) x(code,label,sort_order)
JOIN onboarding_disposition_nodes p ON p.code='OB_TECHNICAL'
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET label=EXCLUDED.label,parent_id=EXCLUDED.parent_id,active=TRUE,sort_order=EXCLUDED.sort_order;
-- Onboarding auto-assignment roster: new cases (seller handoff, Sub Raw sync, admin "auto
-- assign") are shared equally among these people. Existing cases are not moved.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_roster (
  agent_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agents(id),
  added_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

INSERT INTO onboarding_roster(agent_id)
SELECT a.id FROM agents a WHERE a.username IN ('priyanshi','dhruv','ashish')
ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO NOTHING;
-- Onboarding: Sub Raw fields on each case (filled by the daily Sub Raw onboarding sync) for the
-- subscription pills, credits / subscribed-date / stage sorting and the stage filter; and a
-- reopened flag for cases the sync sends back to Open (no ad ran, or the ad failed).
-- Additive only: new nullable columns and a new table.
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_status TEXT;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_cancelled_at DATE;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_credits NUMERIC(14,2);
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_completed_stage TEXT;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reopened_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reopen_reason TEXT CHECK (reopen_reason IN ('no_ad_ran','ad_failed'));

-- Order of onboarding stages (Sub Raw last_completed_stage), lowest rank = earliest stage.
-- Stages not listed sort after the listed ones.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_stage_order (
  stage TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  rank INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- Onboarding: subscription plan (name and amount) and expiry on each case, filled by the daily
-- Sub Raw onboarding sync and shown in the case pane. Additive only: new nullable columns.
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_plan_name TEXT;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_plan_amount NUMERIC(14,2);
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sub_expiry_date DATE;
-- Onboarding admins can remove Lost from a Not Interested / Refund case; it reopens for its owner
-- ("Reopened: by admin"). Additive only.
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS onboarding_cases_reopen_reason_check;
ALTER TABLE onboarding_cases ADD CONSTRAINT onboarding_cases_reopen_reason_check CHECK (reopen_reason IN ('no_ad_ran','ad_failed','callback_requested','refund_callback','admin_removed_lost'));

  WHERE l0_label_snapshot IN ('Not Interested','Refund Requested','Not Interested / Refund') OR l0_code IN ('OB_NOT_INTERESTED_REFUND','OB_NOT_INTERESTED','OB_REFUND_REQUESTED') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.name, a.username,
 count(*)::int cases,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='ads_live')::int live,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='ads_live' AND ${ext})::int live_external,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='open')::int open,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='lost')::int lost,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='lost' AND c.sub_status='ACTIVE' AND c.sub_cancelled_at IS NULL)::int b1,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='lost' AND c.sub_status='ACTIVE' AND c.sub_cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)::int b2,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='lost' AND c.sub_status IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED'))::int b3,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='closed')::int closed,
 count(l.cid)::int ever_lost,
 count(l.cid) FILTER (WHERE c.current_status='ads_live')::int lost_won_back,
 round(avg(GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.ads_live_at-COALESCE(c.sale_date::timestamptz,c.created_at)))/86400.0)) FILTER (WHERE c.ads_live_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT ${ext}),1)::float8 avg_tat

S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-aman-Developer-Pi-Commerce-Call-Center-Disposition-/6b8264a3-f8d0-4cb3-ac93-8bca2b512a61/scratchpad; cat > $S/build.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys, statistics as st
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import FormulaRule
S=sys.argv[1]; OUT=sys.argv[2]
rows=[r for r in json.load(open(f'{S}/agents.json')) if r['name']]
rows.sort(key=lambda r:-r['cases'])
K=5; MIN=20
wb=Workbook(); H=Font(bold=True,color='FFFFFF'); HF=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='1F4E78')
def head(ws,cols):
    ws.append(cols)
    for c in ws[ws.max_row]: c.font=H; c.fill=HF; c.alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True,vertical='center')
    ws.freeze_panes=ws.cell(row=ws.max_row+1,column=2)

# --- Performers
p=wb.active; p.title='Performers'
head(p,['Onboarder','Cases','Ads Live','of which External','Open','Lost now','Live rate','Own live rate (excl external)','Ever marked Lost','Won back from Lost','Win-back rate','Avg days to live','Adjusted live rate','Eligible (>=20 cases)','Rank','Tier'])
n=len(rows); last=n+1
for i,r in enumerate(rows,start=2):
    p.append([r['name'],r['cases'],r['live'],r['live_external'],r['open'],r['lost'],
      f'=C{i}/B{i}',f'=(C{i}-D{i})/B{i}',r['ever_lost'],r['lost_won_back'],f'=IF(I{i}=0,"",J{i}/I{i})',r['avg_tat'],
      f'=(C{i}+{K}*Summary!$B$6)/(B{i}+{K})',f'=IF(B{i}>={MIN},M{i},"")',
      f'=IF(N{i}="","",COUNTIF($N$2:$N${last},">"&N{i})+1)',
      f'=IF(B{i}<{MIN},"Low volume",IF(M{i}>=Summary!$B$9,"Top",IF(M{i}<=Summary!$B$10,"Low","Core")))'])
for col in 'GHKMN':
    for c in p[col][1:]: c.number_format='0.0%'
for c,w in zip('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP',[20,8,9,11,7,9,10,14,11,11,10,10,12,12,7,11]): p.column_dimensions[c].width=w
rng=f'A2:P{last}'
p.conditional_formatting.add(rng,FormulaRule(formula=['$P2="Top"'],fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='C6EFCE')))
p.conditional_formatting.add(rng,FormulaRule(formula=['$P2="Low"'],fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='FFC7CE')))
p.conditional_formatting.add(rng,FormulaRule(formula=['$P2="Low volume"'],fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='EDEDED')))

# --- Summary
s=wb.create_sheet('Summary',0)
PR=f'Performers!$B$2:$B${last}'; PC=f'Performers!$C$2:$C${last}'; PN=f'Performers!$N$2:$N${last}'; PG=f'Performers!$G$2:$G${last}'
s['A1']='Onboarder performance: Top vs Low'; s['A1'].font=Font(bold=True,size=14)
s['A2']='Ranked on adjusted live rate = (Ads Live + 5 x team rate) / (Cases + 5). Small books are pulled toward team rate. Only onboarders with 20+ cases are ranked. Top = at or above P75, Low = at or below P25.'
s['A2'].alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True); s.merge_cells('A2:D2'); s.row_dimensions[2].height=60
data=[('Assigned cases',f'=SUM({PR})'),('Ads Live',f'=SUM({PC})'),('Team live rate',f'=B5/B4'),
 ('Mean live rate (per onboarder, eligible)',f'=AVERAGEIFS({PG},{PR},">={MIN}")'),
 ('Median adjusted rate (eligible)',f'=MEDIAN({PN})'),
 ('P75 cut-off (Top)',f'=PERCENTILE({PN},0.75)'),('P25 cut-off (Low)',f'=PERCENTILE({PN},0.25)'),
 ('Top performers',f'=COUNTIF(Performers!$P$2:$P${last},"Top")'),('Low performers',f'=COUNTIF(Performers!$P$2:$P${last},"Low")'),
 ('Unassigned (external live) excluded',128)]
for j,(k,v) in enumerate(data,start=4): s[f'A{j}']=k; s[f'B{j}']=v
for c in ('B6','B7','B8','B9','B10'): s[c].number_format='0.0%'
s.column_dimensions['A'].width=42; s.column_dimensions['B'].width=14; s.column_dimensions['C'].width=14; s.column_dimensions['D'].width=14
s['A16']='Why not mean / median alone'; s['A16'].font=Font(bold=True)
s['A17']='Mean: one onboarder with 5 cases at 100% beats one with 80 at 85%. Median: robust to outliers, but still ignores volume. Adjusted rate fixes both.'
s['A17'].alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True); s.merge_cells('A17:D17'); s.row_dimensions[17].height=45

# --- Lost buckets
b=wb.create_sheet('Lost buckets')
head(b,['Onboarder','Tier','B1 Active, not cancelled','B2 Active, autopay cancelled','B3 Cancelled / Expired','Total lost','B1 target (80%)','B2 target (60%)','B3 target (37%)','Total target'])
for i,r in enumerate(rows,start=2):
    b.append([r['name'],f'=Performers!P{i}',r['b1'],r['b2'],r['b3'],f'=SUM(C{i}:E{i})',
      f'=ROUND(C{i}*0.8,0)',f'=ROUND(D{i}*0.6,0)',f'=ROUND(E{i}*0.37,0)',f'=SUM(G{i}:I{i})'])
t=last+1; b.append(['Total','']+[f'=SUM({c}2:{c}{last})' for c in 'CDEFGHIJ'])
for c in b[t]: c.font=Font(bold=True)
for c,w in zip('ABCDEFGHIJ',[20,11,12,13,12,9,11,11,11,10]): b.column_dimensions[c].width=w
b.row_dimensions[1].height=45; p.row_dimensions[1].height=45
wb.save(OUT)

# print computed view for chat
team=sum(r['live'] for r in rows)/sum(r['cases'] for r in rows)
for r in rows: r['adj']=(r['live']+K*team)/(r['cases']+K)
el=[r['adj'] for r in rows if r['cases']>=MIN]; q=st.quantiles(el,n=4,method='inclusive')

- **Performers:** one row per onboarder with live rate, own live rate (excluding merchants who went live on their own), win-back rate from Lost, average days to go live, adjusted rate, rank and tier. Rows are colour-coded green for Top, red for Low and grey for Low volume.
- **Lost buckets:** each onboarder's B1/B2/B3 cases with targets of 80% / 60% / 37%.

The numbers come from the live database today, and the screenshot's bucket counts match (159 / 78 / 123). The 128 cases with no assigned onboarder are excluded from the ranking; they're all merchants who went live on their own.

- **Top performer:** Ads Live rate at or above the median (71.4%).
- **Low performer:** Ads Live rate below the mean (62.6%).

from openpyxl.styles import Font,PatternFill,Alignment

ws.append(hdr)
for c in ws[2]: c.font=Font(bold=True,color='FFFFFF'); c.fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='1F4E78'); c.alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True)
ws.row_dimensions[2].height=45; ws.freeze_panes='B3'
F={'Top':'C6EFCE','Low':'FFC7CE','Few days':'EDEDED'}
for p in P:
    ws.append([p['name'],p['tier'],p['days'],p['total'],round(p['mean'],2),p['median'],p['best'],p['zero'],round(p['touch'],1),p['conv']])

for c,w in zip('ABCDEFGHIJ',[20,10,9,9,11,11,8,10,11,11]): ws.column_dimensions[c].width=w
wb.save(OUT)
EOF

I've added a new **"Daily (last 2 months)"** tab to `/Users/aman/Downloads/Onboarder-Top-Low-Performers-2026-11-02.xlsx`.

**How it's counted**
- A **working day** is any day the person logged at least one onboarding call.
- The period is **10 Sep – 1 Nov**. The app only has logged calls from 10 Sep onward, so it covers about 7½ weeks, not a full 2 months. Today is left out because the day isn't finished.
- For each person, the **mean** is total Ads Live ÷ working days. The **median** is the Ads Live count on their typical (middle) day.
- **Team mean = 1.69 Ads Live per day** (average of everyone's daily mean). **Team median = 1.40 per day.**
- **Top** means a daily mean of 1.69 or more. **Low** means below 1.40. **Middle** is in between.

content.text:
I've made the changes on `/onboarding` in `components/OnboardingConsole.tsx`. They're not committed or deployed yet. The typecheck passes, but I haven't opened the page in a browser to look at it.

**1. The Completed tile is now two tiles.**
- The row now reads New · Callbacks Today · Overdue · Open Technical · Ageing Open · All Open · **Ads Live** · **Lost** · Req Call Back.
- Each new tile shows only its own cases, and the From/To dates still apply to both.
- The list heading changes to "Ads Live Cases" or "Lost Cases" to match.
- The All / Ads Live / Lost dropdown on the Completed Cases list is gone.

**2. The subscription filter now has four options.** Together with All, they are:
- All
- Active, not cancelled
- Active but cancelled
- Expired (the plan is over: Sub Raw says CANCELLED or EXPIRED)
- Not in Sub Raw

"Not in Sub Raw" used to be hidden when it had no cases. Now all four show on every tile (Lost, Ads Live, All Open, and so on), with a count on each, even when it's 0. On the **Lost** tile these match the strategy buckets: 159 / 78 / 123.

**Cases now in "Expired":** a merchant whose plan is cancelled or expired used to sit under "Active but cancelled / expired". They now move to "Expired", and their orange case tag stays.

**Not done:** "Req Call Back" already has its own tile, and its list is the callback-request list, so the subscription filter doesn't apply there. If "req a call" meant something else, tell me what it should do.

Should I commit this on a new branch and open a PR?

content: Goal is pushing Ads Live to 90%. The /onboarding page now has separate Ads Live and Lost tiles plus four subscription filters, but it isn't committed or deployed yet. Next: your go-ahead to commit on a new branch and open a PR. (disable recaps in /config)

import json,statistics as st,sys

X=[r for r in json.load(open(f'{S}/agents.json')) if r['name'] and r['cases']<MIN]

for r in R:
    r['closed_n']=r['live']+r['lost']+r['closed']; r['adj']=(r['live']+K*team)/(r['cases']+K); r['close_rate']=r['closed_n']/r['cases']
def prank(key):  # percentile rank 0..100, ties share
    v=sorted(r[key] for r in R); n=len(v)
    for r in R: r['p_'+key]=100*(sum(x<r[key] for x in v)+0.5*(sum(x==r[key] for x in v)-1))/(n-1)
for k in ('cases','closed_n','adj'): prank(k)
for r in R: r['score']=0.25*r['p_cases']+0.25*r['p_closed_n']+0.5*r['p_adj']
sc=[r['score'] for r in R]; q=st.quantiles(sc,n=4,method='inclusive'); P25,P75=q[0],q[2]
for r in R: r['tier']='Top' if r['score']>=P75 else 'Low' if r['score']<=P25 else 'Core'
R.sort(key=lambda r:-r['score'])
print(f"team {team:.1%} P25 {P25:.1f} P75 {P75:.1f} median {st.median(sc):.1f}")

wb=Workbook(); ws=wb.active; ws.title='Ranking'

 f"Adjusted live rate = (Ads Live + 5 x team rate {team:.1%}) / (Cases + 5). Only 20+ cases ranked. Top = score >= P75 ({P75:.1f}); Low = score <= P25 ({P25:.1f}).")
ws['A1'].alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True); ws.merge_cells('A1:L1'); ws.row_dimensions[1].height=55
H=['Rank','Onboarder','Tier','Cases assigned','Cases closed (Live + Lost)','Ads Live','Lost','Open','Live rate','Adjusted live rate','Closure rate','Score (0-100)']
ws.append(H)
for c in ws[2]: c.font=Font(bold=True,color='FFFFFF'); c.fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='1F4E78'); c.alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True)
ws.row_dimensions[2].height=45; ws.freeze_panes='C3'
F={'Top':'C6EFCE','Low':'FFC7CE'}

for r in X: ws.append(['',r['name'],'Under 20 cases',r['cases'],r['live']+r['lost']+r['closed'],r['live'],r['lost']+r['closed'],r['open'],r['live']/r['cases'] if r['cases'] else 0]); ws.cell(ws.max_row,9).number_format='0.0%'
for c,w in zip('ABCDEFGHIJKL',[6,20,13,10,12,9,7,7,9,11,10,10]): ws.column_dimensions[c].width=w
wb.save(OUT)

content.text:
Each score is built in 4 steps.

**Step 1: three numbers for each person**
1. **Cases assigned:** their total cases.
2. **Cases closed:** Ads Live + Lost.
3. **Adjusted live rate:** (Ads Live + 5 × 68%) ÷ (Cases assigned + 5). This works like giving everyone 5 extra "average" cases. A big book barely moves, while a small book gets pulled toward 68%, so 14 out of 14 doesn't count as a perfect 100%.

**Step 2: turn each number into a 0–100 rank within the team**
- Rank = (number of people below you ÷ the 19 other people) × 100.
- The best person gets 100 and the worst gets 0. People who tie share the rank.
- This puts case counts and percentages on the same 0–100 scale, so they can be added together.

**Step 3: weighted total**
> **Score = 25% × assigned rank + 25% × closed rank + 50% × adjusted live rate rank**

Quality (live rate) is half the score; volume (assigned and closed) is the other half.

**Step 4: tier**
- Top: score of 53.9 or more (the top 25% of the team).
- Low: score of 35.7 or less (the bottom 25%).
- Core: everyone in between.

**Worked example: Harsh (54 cases, 54 closed, 40 Ads Live)**

| Measure | Value | People below him | Rank |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assigned | 54 | 10 of 19 | 52.6 |
| Closed | 54 | 10 of 19 | 52.6 |
| Adjusted live rate | (40 + 3.4) ÷ 59 = 73.6% | 12 of 19 | 63.2 |

Score = 0.25 × 52.6 + 0.25 × 52.6 + 0.5 × 63.2 = **57.9**, which puts him in Top.

**Why Yash (14 out of 14 live) ends up Core**

| Measure | Rank |
|---|---|
| Assigned (14 cases) | 10.5 (only 2 people have fewer) |
| Closed (14) | 10.5 |
| Adjusted live rate 91.6% | 94.7 |

Score = 0.25 × 10.5 + 0.25 × 10.5 + 0.5 × 94.7 = **52.6**, just below the Top cut-off. His quality is excellent, but his book is still small.

The 25/25/50 split was my choice, not a fixed rule. If you want quality to count more (for example 20/20/60) or volume to count more, tell me and I'll re-run the ranking.

content.text:
You're right: the ratio can't go above 100% when it's calculated correctly. Mine went over because the two numbers I divided weren't measured on the same set of cases.

- **Ads Live (top of the ratio):** every case the person marked Ads Live during the window, based on who logged it.
- **Assigned (bottom of the ratio):** only cases **still owned by them today** that were assigned during the window.

So a case they made live and that was later moved to someone else counted on top but not on the bottom.

**Priyanshi's 192 Ads Live, checked:**
- 135 are cases assigned to her in the window and still hers.
- **57** are cases she made live that are **now owned by someone else**, most likely through later reassignment or rebalancing.

The real figure is 135 out of 173, which is **78%, not 111%**.

**Fix:** count Ads Live only on the same cases that are in the "assigned" number:

> Ratio = Ads Live among cases assigned to them in the window ÷ cases assigned to them in the window

That can never exceed 100%. Where a case moved between people, credit goes to whoever owned it when it went live.

I've rebuilt the full picture using ownership history: **`/Users/aman/Downloads/Onboarder-Efficiency-Ownership-2026-11-02.xlsx`** (Finder is showing it).

**How it's counted (10 Sep – 1 Nov)**
- I traced each case's owner from its assignment history: auto-assign, reassign, rebalance and language routing.
- A case counts for whoever owned it while it was still open. Cases already live or lost before someone received them aren't counted for that person.
- Cases **moved away while still open** aren't counted for the person they moved from, since they never got to finish them.
- If someone logs Ads Live on another person's case, the credit goes to **the person who logged it**, and the case counts in their handled total too. 64 of Priyanshi's Ads Live were on Dhruv's or Ashish's cases.
- **Efficiency** = Ads Live ÷ cases handled, which now can't go over 100%. **Output** = Ads Live per working day.
- Team medians are **54% efficiency** and **1.14 Ads Live per day**. Top means at or above both medians; Low means below both.

**What it shows**
- **Priyanshi, Ashish and Prashant** are the core of the team: 65–82% efficiency and about 3.5–4.5 Ads Live a day.
- **Dhruv** drops to 44% once Priyanshi's work on his cases is credited to her. His output is still above the team median.
- **Praveen and Dhruv Bansal look better than in the lifetime view.** Many of their unfinished cases were moved to others, so on the cases they actually kept, they convert at 58–63%.
- **Nakka, Priyam and Surya** have a lot of cases in their hands but mark many of them Lost (only 21–32% efficiency). These are coaching cases.
- **Abhishek** converts 67% of his cases but handles very few, only 0.38 Ads Live a day.

The Excel file also has two extra columns: "Moved away" and "Went live on own". Neither is included in efficiency.

**Caveats**
- My replay disagrees with today's case status on 39 of 1,459 cases (about 3%), mostly older imported records.
- Kunal is left out: he had only 2 cases in this period and no Ads Live.
- Sachin has 1 case, so his rank doesn't mean much yet.
